استحجبن (form X)
# اِسْتَحْجَبْنَ (istaḥjabna) /is.taħ.d͡ʒab.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِسْتَحْجَبَ (istaḥjaba)
# اُسْتُحْجِبْنَ (ustuḥjibna) /us.tuħ.d͡ʒib.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِسْتَحْجَبَ (istaḥjaba)
# اِسْتَحْجِبْنَ (istaḥjibna) /is.taħ.d͡ʒib.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِسْتَحْجَبَ (istaḥjaba)
